question: While attempting to find the inverse of a square matrix $A$ by elementary row operations on $A=IA$, the left-hand side is reduced to $\begin{bmatrix}1&3\\0&0\end{bmatrix}$. State whether $A^{-1}$ exists.

options.D: $A^{-1}$ exists only if the entry $3$ is replaced by $0$
